what.text: People in Ukraine were displaced internally and as refugees.
In 2025, UNHCR reported 5224131 refugees from Ukraine.
In 2025, both UNHCR and IDMC reported 3712000 internal IDPs.
The sources don't say where inside the country displaced people live.

why.text: Conflict episodes involved the Government of Ukraine against Maidan, DPR, LPR, and Novorossiya between 2014 and 2022.
Conflict episodes between the Government of Russia (Soviet Union) and Government of Ukraine (Crimea) occurred between 2022 and 2025.
Disasters were also recorded between 2008 and 2025.

when.text: IDMC reported 646500 new conflict displacements in 2014 and 942418 in 2015.
In 2022, IDMC reported 16870323 new conflict displacements, and UNHCR reported 5684177 refugees.
Returns were recorded at 660000 in 2022 and 139251 in 2025.

how.text: UNHCR counts refugees under its mandate at the end of each year.
IDMC conflict new displacement figures count movements rather than individual people.
The sources don't say how people traveled or what housing they use.
